# Kubo Montessori

> Authentic Montessori preschool, child care, and early education serving Peninsula families in San Mateo and Redwood City, California.

## Overview
Kubo Montessori provides child-centered early childhood education rooted in authentic Montessori philosophy for children from 20 months to 6 years of age. Founded in 2006 by Educational Director Mary Gonzalez, Kubo Montessori offers low teacher-to-child ratios (6:1), freshly cooked organic hot lunches, screen-free prepared environments, and collaborative toilet learning without strict potty training deadlines.

## Campuses & Programs
- [San Mateo Campus (Casa dei Bambini)](https://www.kubomontessori.com/san-mateo-preschool-daycare/): Licensed home-based Montessori child care for toddlers and preschoolers (20 months to 6 years), located at 2823 Flores St, San Mateo, CA 94403.
- [Redwood City Campus (Roots N' Wings)](https://www.kubomontessori.com/redwood-city-preschool-center/): Nature-rich preschool center and Transitional Kindergarten (TK) program located at 2323 Euclid Ave, Redwood City, CA 94061.
- [Montessori Programs Overview](https://www.kubomontessori.com/services/): Full-day and half-day programs, enrichment activities including baking, gardening, gymnastics, and language immersion.
- [About Kubo Montessori](https://www.kubomontessori.com/about/): Founder background, teaching philosophy, and over 20 years of early childhood educational history in the Bay Area.
- [Contact & Tour Booking](https://www.kubomontessori.com/contact/): Schedule an in-person campus tour, view campus hours, phone numbers, and admissions details.

## Parent Resources & Guides
- [Parent Handbook](https://www.kubomontessori.com/resources/parent-handbook/): Official school policies, operating schedules, health guidelines, and classroom routines.
- [Montessori vs. Traditional Preschool](https://www.kubomontessori.com/resources/montessori-vs-traditional-preschool/): Comparative analysis of Montessori prepared environments versus conventional preschool methods.
- [Potty Training Policy Guide](https://www.kubomontessori.com/resources/potty-training-preschool-guide/): Details on our no-prerequisite, supportive toilet-learning approach.
- [Home vs. Center-Based Childcare](https://www.kubomontessori.com/resources/home-vs-center-childcare/): Guide to choosing between intimate home daycare environments and larger center-based campuses.
- [Montessori Blog](https://www.kubomontessori.com/blog/): Articles and parenting insights on child development, independence, and Montessori principles.
